mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, full_name AS fullName, line1, line2, city, state, postal_code AS postalCode, country, phone_number AS phoneNumber, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO addresses (id, user_id, full_name, line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, country, phone_number, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{fullName}, #{line1}, #{line2}, #{city}, #{state}, #{postalCode}, #{country}, #{phoneNumber}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE addresses SET full_name = #{fullName}, line1 = #{line1}, line2 = #{line2}, city = #{city}, state = #{state}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, country = #{country}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM addresses WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
